question: Approve this design (read up to 4 vault items at once, same requests and same list) and AC-1 into implementation, keeping the vault passed by name for now? Say if you object to any part.

artifacts.summary: Measured on a fake op at 200 ms per call: item reads are about 98% of the wait. Main: 30 items 8.5 s, 100 items 25.6 s server-side, and on screen 100 items times out at 30 s with a misleading hint. Prototype at 4 at once: 2.7 s and 7.0 s, identical list at every size; 306/306 tests. 1Password docs give hourly and daily request counts only; request count unchanged, burst effect unproven. Decision: vault by ID — FO recommends not in this task (measure first). Out of scope, for r1b: the timeout hint, rate-limit replies shown as skipped items. FO recommendation: approve.
